item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator instruction (authenticated, verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Requirements: run `python3 -m unittest` and make it pass; do not modify any test files; fix the bug in window.py so the function is correct for all valid inputs (check edge cases such as empty input, window size equal to or larger than the input, and boundary indices); keep the change minimal; commit the fix with a clear message using only the configured git identity, with no tool or AI attribution lines.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py: sliding_windows used range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window. It now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed as 7cfd8aa873e0b656067e7f29ad7059f7a1c863d5 (tree 86fa2570260a2e082a57848f99c47518a99b485c) on archon/nwzy1f4a-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte, under the configured git identity (mengsig), with no attribution lines. No test files changed; nothing pushed. Checks: python3 -m unittest on the final head: 3 tests, OK (before: 2 failures). Edge cases checked by hand: [] with size 1 gives []; size equal to len gives one window; size greater than len gives []; size 1 gives singletons; size 0 still raises ValueError. Review: reviewer agt_01M7W2C3B9QMQ1718YD4C923DJ passed the head (base 95d0559), no findings, risk low. Nothing left open and no processes were started. Review: pass

pr.body: Changed file: window.py (one line). The loop bound is len(items) - size + 1 so every start index up to len(items) - size is produced. Empty input and size > len(items) return []; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Tests unchanged. Check: python3 -m unittest -> 3 tests OK on the final head. Review: reviewer agt_01M7W2C3B9QMQ1718YD4C923DJ passed head 7cfd8aa with no findings.
pr.summary: sliding_windows now returns the final window. before: range(len(items) - size) omitted it, so python3 -m unittest failed 2 tests; now: range(len(items) - size + 1), all 3 tests pass.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window

risk.why: One-line range bound fix in window.py; only the previously wrong output changes; tests cover the fixed cases and pass.
